Last backup: —

Backup mein sab kuch save hota hai: invoices, stock, customers, expenses, purchases. GitHub update se pehle zaroor download karein!

✉ Telegram Auto Backup

Har din ka PDF + Excel report (Invoices, Receipts, Purchase, Purchase Dashboard & Supplier Pending Payments, Expenses, P&L, Due Payments, Inventory, Inventory Log, Edit Log) ek ZIP file mein — date wale folder (jaise 13.07.2026) ke andar — apke Telegram par agle din subah 8:30 baje automatically bhej diya jayega (chahe Admin ya Staff, jo bhi pehle app khole). ZIP mein us din ke sabhi Invoices (invoice no. wise, alag-alag PDF), sabhi Payment Receipts, aur sabhi Purchase (Supplier) Payment Receipts bhi alag folders mein shamil hote hain. Agar kai din backup miss hua ho, sabhi pending din ek-ek karke bhej diye jaate hain. JSON file nahi bhejta.

Kisi bhi purani date ka backup chahiye ho to yahan date select karke neeche button dabayein. Manual backup kitni bhi baar bhejein, isse roz subah 8:30 baje wala automatic backup kabhi skip nahi hoga — dono ek dusre se independent hain.

Last Telegram backup: —

Setup: 1) Telegram par @BotFather ko message karke /newbot se bot banayein aur token copy karein. 2) Apne bot ko message bhejein (ya use group mein add karein), phir @userinfobot / @getidsbot se apna Chat ID nikaal lein. 3) Token & Chat ID yahan daal kar Save karein.
